title: 1993 🇬🇧 #UFOB [CASE] Sightings - The Cosford Triangle flap in the UK convinced Nick Pope.
description:
The Cosford Incident, took place on 30 and 31 March 1993. Multiple sightings came in from around the UK over a period of six hours overnight; witnesses included military police at one airbase and the meteorological officer at a second. 

The latter described seeing a vast triangular-shaped craft flying slowly over the base, making a low-frequency humming sound, before suddenly accelerating away, many times faster than a military jet.
